scope: 2024-06 pre-deduction components of 500-500000 m2 that are either fully removed with reservoir involvement or partially removed with a reservoir-dominant deduction group
limits: The 18 visual labels in this scope are proxy evidence, not field truth.
The review sample is stratified and cannot estimate population accuracy.
No threshold is selected and no candidate is restored in this experiment.
Source flags describe upstream evidence paths and are not land-cover classes.
